description:
Edit a deployed bot. One call can rename it, switch it to another strategy or apply a preset, change its timeframe, execution mode or run interval, set strategy parameters, change its version channel, and change its risk settings (leverage, position size %, stop loss, take profit), trade notifications or stopAfterClose. All of it goes in ONE update, so a strategy switch never lands half-done.

Merging: the bot's current settings are fetched first and your changes go on top. Grouped settings (positionSizing, messaging, spinConfig, parameterOverrides) are merged, never wiped by a partial change. Size and leverage are NEVER changed unless you pass positionSizePercent / leverage, also when you switch strategy or apply a preset.

Strategy switch (strategyId) and timeframe change need the bot to be FLAT: no open position and no working order. A bot that holds one is refused (OPEN_POSITION) and nothing is changed, because the new strategy would adopt a position it did not open (e.g. a long-only strategy inheriting a short). Pause it first with stopAfterClose:true (it keeps managing the position, opens nothing new and pauses once flat), wait until get_bot_status shows no openPosition, then switch. A switch starts the strategy state over and drops the old strategy's parameters, preset and stale owed exits; the new strategy runs its stable channel unless you pass versionChannel / pinnedVersionId. The bot keeps its status: a paused bot stays paused until you start_bot it.

Preset (presetId): applies it as the dashboard does when you pick one: its strategy, parameter overrides, timeframe, execution mode / interval and version, with anything you pass explicitly on top. The same flat rule applies when it changes the strategy or timeframe.

Scope: editing a paper bot needs mcp:paper; any change to a LIVE bot (rename, strategy, timeframe, parameters, risk) needs mcp:live. The server enforces it (INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE).

Returns the resulting config (strategy, version and channel, timeframe, mode, parameter overrides, size, leverage, status) and any server warnings, e.g. that the exchange cannot supply enough candle history. A stopAfterClose-only call returns a one-line confirmation. Get bot IDs from list_bots; check current values with get_bot_status.

executionMode.description: "on_bar_close" runs the strategy once per closed candle (what backtests simulate); "continuous" runs it every interval. Omit to keep it.

id.description: The bot ID to update, obtained from list_bots.

leverage.description: New leverage. Omit to leave unchanged.

name.description: New bot name. Omit to keep it.

notifyOnTrade.description: Whether to send a Telegram notification for each trade this bot executes. Omit to leave unchanged.

parameterOverrides.description: Strategy parameters to set, e.g. {"ENABLE_SHORTS": true, "VOL_SKIP_PCT": 80}. Merged into the bot's current overrides (or the preset's, with presetId); a null value removes that key so the strategy default runs. After a strategy switch these are the only overrides.

pinnedVersionId.description: Pin this strategy version ID (sets versionChannel "custom"). Version IDs come from list_strategy_versions.

positionSizePercent.description: New position size as a percentage of account balance per trade. Omit to leave unchanged.

presetId.description: Apply this bot preset: its ID or slug (e.g. "trade-wind-long-short"). Writes the preset's strategy, parameter overrides, timeframe, execution mode / interval and version; anything you pass explicitly wins. Never changes size or leverage.

resetParameterOverrides.description: true: drop all current parameter overrides first (the strategy defaults run), then apply parameterOverrides if given.

spinIntervalSeconds.description: Run interval in seconds. An on_bar_close bot still runs every closed bar; the server brings a longer interval down to the bar. Omit to keep it.

stopAfterClose.description: true: keep managing the open position, open no new entries, pause automatically once flat (immediately if already flat); false: cancel. Only an active bot can be set. Changing the bot's status (start_bot/stop_bot) also cancels it. Use it to get a bot flat before a strategy or timeframe change. Omit to leave unchanged.

stopLoss.description: New stop loss %. Omit to leave unchanged.

strategyId.description: Switch to this strategy: its ID or slug (e.g. "trade-wind", "supertrend-momentum"). The bot must be flat (see above). Its parameter overrides and preset are cleared unless you pass parameterOverrides / presetId; size and leverage are kept. Omit to keep the strategy.

takeProfit.description: New take profit %. Omit to leave unchanged.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe the bot trades on, e.g. "15m", "1h", "4h". Changing it needs the bot to be flat. Omit to keep it.

versionChannel.description: Strategy version channel: "stable" (default for a switch), "beta", "latest", or "custom" (needs pinnedVersionId). Omit to keep it.

name: update_bot
